content.comment_body: Here's what I'm aiming to do: I have two sensors, one for speed and another for temperature. I plan to create a program that allows me to adjust both temperature and speed using the controller's buttons. Both sensors send their data to a variable called 'and', which enables control of the speed—something I also wish to adjust. My goal is to manage all these settings using controller buttons. To test this, I'm working within [product_name] V8.3 software since I don't have the actual controller yet and need to prove the concept works.
In another topic you posted about controlling a frequency converter with [product_name], I uploaded a program for the feature you requested.

This thread was closed because the question was posted twice. The other thread, about controlling a frequency converter with [product_name], is available within the [product_name] - Software conference. Best regards, [user_name]

analysis.insight_summary: User aims to simulate adjusting sensor values using controller buttons in the [product_name] V8.3 environment, but cannot proceed due to not having physical hardware. The conversation emphasizes testing logic within the software before moving to actual hardware. Replies indicate the question has been covered in another discussion.
analysis.user_expectations: User wants to completely configure and adjust sensor-driven logic with controller buttons during simulation, without needing actual controller hardware.
